name: claude-skills
description: Thirty-two Agent Skills for writing, CV work, cloud/IaC, docs, images, diagrams, reports and job search — each with its boundaries written down. MIT.

interface.shortDescription: Thirty-two skills that each say what they will not do.
interface.longDescription: Writing and CV work (clear-and-human, hook-and-human, readability, cv-and-human, cv-evidence-base, cv-cover-letter, interview-panel, python-drill), cloud and IaC (terragrunt-skill, terraform-registry, azadvertizer), docs and research (c7search, markdown-converter, source-snapshot, adr-author), publishing and capture (ghost-publish, trilium-capture, transcribe-summarize), images and diagrams (nano-banana-pro-json, convert-to-webp, social-image-prep, excalidraw-diagram), reports and audits (report-builder, ux-audit), agent tooling (dev-fleet, frontier-rounds, spec-ready, spec-to-tickets, use-linearis), planning (travel-planning, business-plan), and job search (job-feeds). Every skill ships a stated boundary — what it refuses to do and why — because a tool that will invent a number to fill a gap is worse than one that stops. MIT licensed.
defaultPrompt: Review this draft and tell me whether it reads like AI wrote it.
Tailor my CV to this job description without inventing anything.
Turn this data into a single self-contained HTML report.
Find remote jobs matching my background from public feeds only.
